score_observations: Opening page, Lento quarter = approximately 63 in 4/4: after a four-measure piano introduction, soprano enters softly with slurred chromatic motion. The next line has long, densely beamed chromatic runs with triplet, quintuplet and sextuplet subdivisions. The excerpt is only seven measures and does not establish the full range.
